mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) potentiates insulin secretion and increases glipizide's hypoglycemic effect through inhibition of monoamine oxidase, while also inhibiting hepatic metabolism of glipizide via CYP2C9 inhibition.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor blood glucose closely with potential dose reduction of glipizide; counsel patient on hypoglycemia symptoms and maintain dietary consistency.
